en..alarm.h: Help comes fast if it happens again.
en..help: A home help a few hours a week
en..none.h: A first fall often leads to another.

zh..x: 你在厨房滑倒，在地上躺了一个小时才爬起来。
zh..alarm.h: 万一再跌倒，很快就有人来。
zh..help: 请居家帮手每周几小时
zh..none.h: 跌倒一次，常常还会再跌。

zht..x: 你在廚房滑倒，在地上躺了一個小時才爬起來。
zht..alarm.h: 萬一再跌倒，很快就有人來。
zht..help: 請居家幫手每週幾小時
zht..none.h: 跌倒一次，常常還會再跌。

events.src: ESTIMATE: game rule (home care and care-home fees as shares of a typical wage; long-term care insurance pays most of it)

opts.do: health -= 4; T('l_care2', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.l_care2')}); rec('l_care2', (ltc ? .3 : 1) * .15 * base, 5)
health -= 2; happy += 1; T('l_care2', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.l_care2')}); rec('l_care2', (ltc ? .3 : 1) * .3 * base, 8)

en..x: A second fall has broken your wrist. Living alone has become hard.
en..home.h: Health −4 from the fall. Long-term care insurance pays most of this, if you have it.
en..village.h: Health −2, Happiness +1: help on hand. Insurance helps if you have it.

zh..x: 第二次跌倒摔断了手腕。一个人住越来越难了。
zh..home.h: 跌倒让健康 −4。如果有长期照护险，大部分由保险付。
zh..village.h: 健康 −2，幸福感 +1：随时有人帮忙。有保险的话会帮你付。

zht..x: 第二次跌倒摔斷了手腕。一個人住越來越難了。
zht..home.h: 跌倒讓健康 −4。如果有長照險，大部分由保險付。
zht..village.h: 健康 −2，幸福感 +1：隨時有人幫忙。有保險的話會幫你付。

events.src: Flu and pneumonia vaccines cut serious illness in older people (WHO, Vaccines for older adults, 2023)

opts.do: if (roll('l_vaccine') < .12) { health -= 5; pay(.03 * base); log(M('log.l_flu', {a: MN(.03 * base)}), 'bad') }

en..x: The clinic offers flu and pneumonia vaccines to over-65s.
en..no.h: About one in eight unvaccinated older people ends up in hospital with flu or pneumonia in a bad winter.
en.log.l_flu: You spent a week in hospital with pneumonia. It cost {a}.

zh..x: 诊所给65岁以上的人打流感和肺炎疫苗。
zh..no.h: 坏的冬天里，没打疫苗的老人大约八个有一个会因流感或肺炎住院。
zh.log.l_flu: 你得肺炎住院一星期，花了{a}。

zht..x: 診所給65歲以上的人打流感和肺炎疫苗。
zht..no.h: 壞的冬天裡，沒打疫苗的老人大約八個有一個會因流感或肺炎住院。
zht.log.l_flu: 你得肺炎住院一星期，花了{a}。

en..x: The community centre runs gentle exercise classes: tai chi, swimming, chair yoga.
en..class.h: Health a little better every year, and new friends.
en..walk.h: Health a little better every year.

zh..x: 社区中心有温和的运动课：太极、游泳、椅子瑜伽。
zh..class.h: 健康每年好一点，还能交新朋友。

zht..x: 社區中心有溫和的運動課：太極、游泳、椅子瑜伽。
zht..class.h: 健康每年好一點，還能交新朋友。

en..x: The walk to the shops has become too far for you.
en..none: Ask neighbours to shop for you

zh..x: 走到商店对你来说已经太远了。

zht..x: 走到商店對你來說已經太遠了。

events.src: ESTIMATE: game rule (home care and care-home fees as shares of a typical wage; long-term care insurance pays most of it)

opts.do: T('l_ch', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.l_ch')}); rec('l_ch', (ltc ? .3 : 1) * .2 * base, 10); health += 1
T('l_ch', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.l_ch')}); rec('l_ch', (ltc ? .3 : 1) * .45 * base, 10); health += 3; happy -= 1

en..x: You can no longer manage alone. Your doctor talks you through the options.
en..home.h: Health +1. Long-term care insurance pays most of this, if you have it.
en..care.h: Health +3, Happiness −1. Long-term care insurance pays most of this, if you have it.

zh..x: 你已经没办法独自生活了。医生跟你说明有哪些选择。
zh..home.h: 健康 +1。如果有长期照护险，大部分由保险付。
zh..care.h: 健康 +3，幸福感 −1。如果有长期照护险，大部分由保险付。

zht..x: 你已經沒辦法獨自生活了。醫生跟你說明有哪些選擇。
zht..home.h: 健康 +1。如果有長照險，大部分由保險付。
zht..care.h: 健康 +3，幸福感 −1。如果有長照險，大部分由保險付。

en..x: You keep losing your keys and forgetting names. It worries you.
en..care: Talking to a doctor early helps, whatever the cause.
en..private.h: Happiness +1: you know where you stand sooner.

zh..x: 你老是找不到钥匙、记不住名字，这让你担心。
zh..care: 不管原因是什么，早点跟医生谈都有帮助。
zh..private.s: 大约{a}，几个星期内就能做。

zht..x: 你老是找不到鑰匙、記不住名字，這讓你擔心。
zht..care: 不管原因是什麼，早點跟醫生談都有幫助。
zht..private.s: 大約{a}，幾個星期內就能做。

en..x: Cooking for one has become a chore, and you often skip meals.
en..deliver.h: Health a little better each year.

zh..x: 一个人煮饭越来越麻烦，你常常干脆不吃。

zht..x: 一個人煮飯越來越麻煩，你常常乾脆不吃。

en..x: Your old dentures no longer fit, and eating has become a struggle.
en..implant.h: Happiness +2, Health +1: you eat properly again.

zh..x: 旧假牙已经不合了，吃东西很辛苦。
zh..implant.h: 幸福感 +2，健康 +1：又能好好吃东西了。

zht..x: 舊假牙已經不合了，吃東西很辛苦。
zht..implant.h: 幸福感 +2，健康 +1：又能好好吃東西了。
